headline: Vornado Q3 Earnings Miss Expectations as Revenue Falls Short
summary: Vornado reported third-quarter earnings that missed analyst projections by $0.12, while revenue also fell short of consensus estimates.
why: Quarterly earnings results for real estate investment trusts reflect commercial property market conditions, leasing demand, and rental income trends.

impacts.name: Vornado Realty Trust
impacts.why: Earnings and revenue misses generally exert downward pressure on a company's stock price.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
